description: This file is a PHP source file that sets up and displays report filters within the vtiger CRM application. It initializes required dependencies, assigns variables to a Smarty template, includes additional filter scripts, and renders a template for report filtering.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering report filter UI.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders a template file using Smarty.
